profile.visual_desc: Bald elf with pointed ears and a goatee. Wears voluminous red robes, a spiked yellow mantle, and blue hem trim.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Stern expression with sharp green eyes and a thin goatee. Features bald head and prominent elven ears.
profile.weapon_desc: Blue scepter with a circular orb head, held in the right hand.
profile.step1_ready: Standing rear-view facing ↖; staff held high over the right shoulder in a neutral casting stance.
profile.step2_windup: Shifts weight forward slightly, bracing the torso while maintaining staff position.
profile.step3_impact: Drops into a deep forward crouch facing ↖; staff thrusts downward to channel a magical pulse at the base.
profile.step4_finish: Maintains the low kneeling follow-through as energy dissipates, transitioning back to a standing pose.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: The magical release occurs at the lowest point of the downward staff thrust, following a vertical casting arc.

evaluation.diagnosis: The sequence successfully adapts the source material. Biomechanics and VFX alignment are consistent with the original's upward-left perspective and casting motion.
